detail.longDescription:
NetPulse Pro is a professional network, WiFi, security, OSINT, and forensics toolkit for Android. Diagnose internet problems, inspect local networks, check domains and servers, review security signals, and understand what is happening on your connection.

Built for IT admins, network engineers, cybersecurity learners, developers, support teams, and power users, NetPulse Pro brings 150+ practical tools into one mobile command center.

WHY NETPULSE PRO

Fast troubleshooting
Check ping, latency, packet loss, jitter, speed, DNS quality, ISP issues, routes, ports, SSL, headers, IP reputation, WiFi signal, connected devices, and more.

Made for real users
Use clear categories, search, favorites, saved history, Smart Scan, and live network status such as public IP, gateway, VPN state, quick ping, packet loss, and health score.

Easy to understand
Results are readable and useful, with context for DNS records, ports, protocols, certificates, HTTP headers, device discovery, and risk indicators.

150+ tools in one app
Replace many small utilities with one toolkit for diagnostics, lookup, WiFi, LAN discovery, security, privacy, OSINT, forensics education, and everyday troubleshooting.

TOOLS INCLUDED

Network diagnostics
Ping, Traceroute, Speed Test, Packet Loss, Jitter Test, Connection Quality, DNS Benchmark, MTU Finder, TCP Tester, Stress Test, Ping Flood, Packet Analyzer, Latency Map, ISP Outage, ISP Throttling Check, Speed Logger, iPerf Setup, and Smart Scan.

WiFi, LAN, and wireless
WiFi Analyzer, Network Scanner, Bandwidth Monitor, Net Monitor, ARP Table, Route Table, Wake on LAN, Port Forward Test, Service Browser, Bluetooth Scanner, Cellular Analyzer, WiFi Heatmap, Network Topology, Subnet Scanner, Ping Sweep, Wireless Spectrum, Node Locator, and device discovery.

Security checks
Port Scanner, SSL Checker, SSL Chain Audit, HTTP Security Headers, VPN Detector, DNS Leak checks, IP Reputation, Certificate Transparency, Intruder Alert, IP Camera Scanner, Router Risk Review, DNS Poison Audit, Phishing Header Audit, CORS Interrogator, JWT Auditor, Password Strength, Clickjack Test, Bucket Auditor, Suspicious Link Analyzer, WiFi Trust Auditor, Skimmer Guard, Sensor Ghost, and Honeypot Trap.

Lookup and domain intelligence
DNS Lookup, Whois, IP Info, Reverse IP, IP Geofence, MAC Lookup, BGP Lookup, ASN Info, IPv6 Details, MX Validator, SPF Checker, DKIM Checker, DMARC Checker, DNS Propagation, Subdomain Finder, Port Service Lookup, Historical Whois, Surface Mapper, and domain footprint checks.

Privacy, OSINT, and forensics
Tracker X-Ray, Metadata Scrubber, Clipboard Guard, Acoustic Shadow, Sinkhole Audit, Identity Shadow, Handle Sniper, Profile X-Ray, Profile Hunter, Profile Extractor, Phone OSINT, Dark Intel, Dark Web Validator, Typo-Squat Audit, EXIF GPS review, Deep Fake Checker, Cell Tower Triangulator, USB Interrogator, Battery Drain Forensics, Hash Decryptor, and AI image checks.

Utility tools
Subnet Calculator, IP Calculator, Network Calculator, Network Unit Converter, cURL / HTTP Client, HTTP Status Checker, PageSpeed Insights, QR Generator, WiFi Vault & QR, Base64 Converter, URL Encoder, JSON Formatter, MAC Generator, User Agent Analyzer, Data Usage, System Info, DNS Changer, SSH Client, Link Tracker, Speed Compare, and networking cheatsheets.

BEST FOR

- Fixing slow internet, unstable WiFi, high ping, packet loss, and DNS problems
- Finding devices on your local network and checking router health
- Checking SSL, ports, headers, IP reputation, domain records, and server status
- Learning networking, routing, DNS, web security, OSINT, and forensics concepts
- Running authorized diagnostics and security reviews from Android

IMPORTANT

NetPulse Pro is for diagnostics, learning, troubleshooting, and authorized security testing only. Scan, test, or audit only networks, domains, accounts, and devices you own or have permission to assess.

Download NetPulse Pro and turn your Android phone into a complete network command center.
